description: This is a Java source file containing integration tests for the Survey functionality in the Apache Fineract project. It includes test cases for creating, retrieving, and verifying surveys with various properties, questions, and inputs.

classes.name: SurveyIntegrationTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for integration testing survey functionalities in Apache Fineract. Includes setup and multiple test cases for creating, retrieving, and validating surveys.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes the test environment and sets up helper objects before each test.

methods.name: testCreateSurvey
methods.description: Tests creation of a new survey with specific validity period and questions.

methods.name: testCreateSurveyWithDefaultValidity
methods.description: Tests creation of a survey using default validity timeframe.

methods.name: testCreateSurveyWithInvalidData
methods.description: Verifies that creating a survey with invalid data (e.g., empty questions) throws an exception.

methods.name: testRetrieveActiveSurveys
methods.description: Checks that active surveys can be retrieved and the created survey exists in the list.

methods.name: testSurveyProperties
methods.description: Validates that survey properties match the expected values after creation.

methods.name: testCreateSurveyWithMultipleQuestions
methods.description: Tests survey creation with multiple questions and verifies question count.

methods.name: testCreateSurveyWithSpecialCharacters
methods.description: Verifies that surveys with special characters in name, description, and questions can be created successfully.

methods.name: testCreateSurveyWithLongText
methods.description: Tests survey creation with long description and questions to ensure handling of long text inputs.

methods.name: generateSurveyName
methods.description: Generates a unique survey name based on timestamp.

methods.name: createTestSurvey
methods.description: Creates a survey with provided description and questions for testing purposes.

methods.name: findSurveyByName
methods.description: Retrieves a survey by name from the list of active surveys.

methods.name: verifyCreatedSurveyExists
methods.description: Checks that a survey with a specific name exists in the list.

methods.name: verifySurveyProperties
methods.description: Asserts that the given survey's properties match expected values.

methods.name: buildLongDescription
methods.description: Constructs a long descriptive string for testing long text inputs.

methods.name: buildLongQuestion
methods.description: Constructs a long question string for testing purposes.
